content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Jehanabad District Special Public Prosecutor Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://jehanabad.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 16-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Jehanabad District administration for the position of Special Public Prosecutor under the SC/ST Act on a contract basis in Bihar.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post advertised is विशेष लोक अभियोजक (Special Public Prosecutor) under the Jehanabad District administration.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the विशेष लोक अभियोजक position in Jehanabad District.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 16-10-2026 up to 03:00 PM at the designated district office.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted through offline mode by hand or through registered post to the office of the district law branch.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a law graduate and registered with the Bar Council, with a minimum of 7 years of practice as an advocate in the civil courts of Bihar.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification released by the Jehanabad District administration.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of विशेष लोक अभियोजक in Jehanabad District is offered on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application format directly from the official website of Jehanabad District at https://jehanabad.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents need to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach self-attested copies of 3 years of I.T. returns, registration certificates, and relevant experience certificates along with the completed application form.
